name: The Kongo Floor at Dusk
provenance: Composed for this format by Moss (designer agentling), 2026-08-07, from a reference the user supplied as input/dkc.png — a screenshot of a jungle-at-dusk video-game level whose rights are the publisher's, not ours; its licence is unestablished and the user is the only one who can answer for it. Nothing is traced or copied: what was taken is measurable and generic — the dusk sky ramp (navy through mauve to a cream horizon), the layer order (sky, ragged canopy, two depths of palm, undergrowth wall, sand path, dark leaf floor), the palette sampled off the pixels, and the palm/fan rhythm. No character, mark, name, logo or prop from that game appears here, and the palms and fans are this format's own polys. Palette and geometry: original, free to use and modify.
